notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on 1934 build and 1971 destruction and on the 20-foot L-4 tower. Location and elevation match the record's coordinates and county. The 1959 staffing rests on one name in two pages that cite the same source. The only account of remains is a single visit post dated November 14, 2024, and no source gives an owner or access level beyond the drive-up tag.
